chapters.title: Good Morning
chapters.intro: The sun is up over the little farm by the lake. Somebody is very hungry.
chapters.completeText: Breakfast is over, and the ball is back. What a good start to the summer!

chapters.title: The Kite
chapters.intro: It is a sunny day, and the shop by the park is open. Everyone wants something new.
chapters.completeText: The kite is safe, and the birds are singing. Tomorrow it will fly even higher!

chapters.title: Apple Pie
chapters.intro: The trees behind the farm are full of fruit. Mom has a sweet plan for today.
chapters.completeText: Not one crumb is left. Next time Mom will bake two pies!

chapters.title: The Hen House
chapters.intro: Behind the barn there is a noisy little house. Grandpa goes there every morning.
chapters.completeText: A basket full of eggs and a nap for the chicks. The hen house is quiet again.

chapters.title: The Old Boat
chapters.intro: The ice is gone and the lake is blue again. The old boat is out of the shed.
chapters.completeText: The boat is painted, and it floats! Tomorrow they will row to the island.

chapters.title: The Picnic
chapters.intro: The sun is warm and the grass is soft. Everyone is getting ready to go out.
chapters.completeText: Everyone is full and happy, and the ants get the last crumbs!

chapters.title: Farm Work
chapters.intro: Grandpa is in town today, so the farm work is up to the family. The animals are waiting.
chapters.completeText: Everybody is fed and clean. Grandpa will be proud of his helpers!

chapters.title: Bath Time
chapters.intro: After the rain the yard is one big puddle. It is time to clean up.
chapters.completeText: The dog is clean and shiny, for now. But where did the soap go?

chapters.title: The Fox
chapters.intro: It is late at night on the farm. Something is creeping along the fence.
chapters.completeText: The fox ran off with nothing at all, and the dog is the hero of the night.

chapters.title: A Rainy Day
chapters.intro: Rain is drumming on the roof all day long. Nobody can go out to play.
chapters.completeText: The letter was from Mom and Dad, and the rain is over. Tomorrow they can play outside again.

chapters.title: Tom's Birthday
chapters.intro: Today Tom turns six! The whole house is busy and full of secrets.
chapters.completeText: One big cake, one big wish and a very loud drum. Happy birthday, Tom!

chapters.title: Painted Eggs
chapters.intro: It is spring and the hens are very busy. There are eggs everywhere!
chapters.completeText: Every egg is found. The little chick thinks the painted egg is a new friend!

chapters.title: The Old Bike
chapters.intro: Something old has been in the shed all winter. Today it comes out.
chapters.completeText: The bell rings, the wheels spin, and everyone gets a ride. Tomorrow Tom will try it on his own!

chapters.title: At the Sea
chapters.intro: The family takes the train to the seaside. The sand is hot and the water is cool.
chapters.completeText: The sea took the castle, but Tom has a bucket of shells. They will build a bigger one tomorrow.

chapters.title: The Big Pumpkin
chapters.intro: Autumn has come to the farm. The garden is full of good things to pick.
chapters.completeText: Half of it is a funny face and half of it is a pie. Grandma says it was the best one yet!

chapters.title: Night in the Tent
chapters.intro: The family is camping by the lake tonight.
chapters.completeText: The owls are asleep, and breakfast is on the fire. What a night!

chapters.title: The Snowman
chapters.intro: Snow fell all night, and the whole farm is white.
chapters.completeText: The snowman has a carrot nose and a hat. Meg says good night to him, and hot tea is waiting inside!

chapters.title: The Little Mouse
chapters.intro: There is a tiny hole in the wall of Grandma's kitchen. Somebody small lives there.
chapters.completeText: Surprise! The little mouse is a mother. Now three mice live in Meg's tiny house.

chapters.title: Bedtime
chapters.intro: The day is over and the stars are out. It is time to get ready for bed.
chapters.completeText: The story is read, the light is out, and the whole house is asleep. Good night!

chapters.title: Goodbye, Farm
chapters.intro: Summer is over, and it is time to go back to town. There is a lot to do before the long trip.
chapters.completeText: Grandpa waves until the car is gone. See you next summer, farm!
